title: Does Starlink have a contract? A $0 rental kit, no fixed term in the US and UK, and the 30-day refund
seoTitle: Does Starlink have a contract? Rental, cancel, refund
description: In Nevada and London the Starlink kit is a $0 rental with no contract, and you return it if you cancel. See the three plans, the 30-day refund and how to cancel.
metaDescription: Starlink in the US and UK: no contract, a $0 rental kit you return if you cancel, a 30-day refund and the steps to cancel from your account.
imageAlt: Starlink dish in the snow in front of a chalet with a person working inside. The cover reads “Contract and cancelling”.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: On the order pages we read for Nevada and London, Starlink had no contract: the kit is a rental at $0 upfront and $0 a month (£0 in the UK), and you return it if you cancel. The monthly prices shown are promotional and have no fixed duration, and Starlink may update pricing with 30 days' notice. If you cancel and return the kit undamaged within 30 days of the payment due date, the offer refunds the kit and the first month. It is not the same everywhere: in Brazil and Mexico, a subsidised kit can come with a 12-month term.

New customers can get a $100 bill credit in the US or £40 in the UK. Open our referral link before you order, check that the reward is shown, and keep your eligible subscription paid and active for two full billing cycles.

contentSections.heading: United States: three plans, one rental model
paragraphs: On the Nevada order page we read on November 23, 2026, Residential 100 Mbps was $38.50 a month: the regular $55 a month minus a $16.50 promotional adjustment of 30%. It comes with a Starlink V5 and a Router Mini as a rental. The $349 rental kit is credited back at checkout, so the hardware is $0 upfront and $0 a month. Professional installation is optional at $99.

Residential 200 Mbps was $59.50 a month (regular $85, minus $25.50), with a Starlink V4 and a Router 4 as a rental and free professional installation. Max was $91 a month (regular $130, minus $39), with a Standard 4 X and an extra Router Mini as a rental, also with free installation. On all three, $20 plus taxes was due today for shipping.

The page is explicit about the exit: if you cancel service, you will have to return your Starlink hardware rental. We did not see an early cancellation fee, and the FAQ on the order summary says the stated monthly price does not have a fixed duration and that Starlink may update pricing with 30 days' notice.

contentSections.heading: United Kingdom: no contracts, same rental idea
paragraphs: For an address in Westminster, London, the page said "No contracts". Residential 100 Mbps was £40 a month with a Mini Rental and a Router Mini at £0, 200 Mbps was £60 and Max was £80, both with a Standard 4 at £0. We saw no promotional discount in the UK order summary. Shipping was £19, and professional installation is optional at £74 on 100 and 200 Mbps and free on Max. As in the US, you return the rented hardware if you cancel.

contentSections.heading: The 30 days to return it
paragraphs: To ask for the refund of the kit and the first month under the offer, cancel the service and return the equipment undamaged within 30 days of the payment due date shown on that order.
Cancelling the subscription stops future charges according to the billing cycle. Through Starlink support, check how to open the kit return too, and keep the shipping receipt.
The [Starlink referral](/en/coupons/starlink) link opens the same order on the official site. Check the rental and return terms on your own order summary before you pay.

A rental is not universal. In some countries, such as Brazil and Mexico, the kit is bought, and a subsidised kit can come with a 12-month term and an early termination fee after the 30 days. That is why the order summary for your own address is the one that counts.

contentSections.heading: How to cancel
paragraphs: On the home page of your Starlink account, open “Your subscription”. Next to the plan, select “Manage” and then “Cancel Service”.
To avoid a new billing cycle, make the change before 00:00 UTC on your billing date.

According to the help center, the service stays active until the end of the paid period. If you change your mind before it ends, look for “Resume” on the home page. Reactivating after a cancellation depends on availability in your area.
bullets: Sign in to your account on the Starlink website and, on the “Home” page, select “Your subscription”.
Next to the plan, click “Manage” and then “Cancel Service”.
Billing follows UTC. The change has to be made before 00:00 UTC on the billing date, or it only counts for the next cycle.
The service stays active until the date already paid, and no further charges follow.
Before the change takes effect, you can back out with “Resume”, in the “Your service plan will end on...” alert at the top of the “Home” page.
After cancelling, you may not be able to reactivate right away. Reactivation depends on availability in your area.
postParagraphs: Cancelling the service does not return the kit by itself. Returning the kit within 30 days has its own rule, described above.

contentSections.heading: Promotional price and plan changes
paragraphs: The prices on the order pages were 30% off the regular monthly price in the places we checked, offered through the end of November. The page says the stated monthly price does not have a fixed duration and that Starlink may update pricing with 30 days' notice. Cancelling or changing plan can also end a promotional price, so read the terms on your order before you change anything.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay: check your order
paragraphs: The referral only counts if the order starts from a referral link, opened before you pay and on starlink.com. After the payment, or on a marketplace, it cannot be added. Opening the link commits you to nothing: your address shows which model applies to you, and the 30 days cover the test. The referral credit is $100 in the US and £40 in the UK, lands on your bill after two months of service and does not lower the price of the kit.

contentSections.heading: If the charges continue
paragraphs: If you are still charged, open a ticket with Starlink and include the order number, the cancellation date and the case number, if you have one. If you do not recognize a transaction, contact your card issuer or bank as well.
Check [Starlink's reputation on Trustpilot](/en/reviews/starlink-trustpilot-reviews) to see what other customers report about billing and support.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Starlink have a discount code? No. Starlink has no coupon: through Cecília's referral link, a new subscriber gets $100 in the US and £40 in the UK after two months of service, as a credit on the bill, and the person who referred gets the same amount.

Does Starlink have a contract? On the pages we read in Nevada and London, no: the kit was a rental at $0 upfront and $0 a month, and the UK page said "No contracts". In Brazil and Mexico, a subsidised kit can carry a 12-month term. Confirm the terms on the summary of your own order.

What is the fee to cancel Starlink? We did not see an early cancellation fee on the US and UK pages. You do have to return the rented hardware if you cancel. Check the summary of your order before you confirm.
Can I cancel Starlink at any time? You can request it from your account. Cancelling stops future charges, and you have to return the rented hardware.
Do I have to send the Starlink kit back? Yes. The page says that if you cancel service, you will have to return your Starlink hardware rental.
Is the monthly price fixed? No. The FAQ on the order summary says the stated monthly price does not have a fixed duration and that Starlink may update pricing with 30 days' notice.

Can I return Starlink within 30 days? The offer describes a refund of the kit and the first month if you cancel and return the kit undamaged within 30 days of the payment due date, as stated on that order.
